description: AML — Telemetria Geoespacial (OGC WFS) — Inundações e Nível do Mar is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Área Metropolitana de Lisboa . Open geospatial data service in accordance with the OGC WFS standard, provided by the Lisbon Metropolitan Area (AML) under the Metropolitan Urban Management Platform – Lot 2. Coverage: Área Metropolitana de Lisboa . The portal shows the English title as "AML — Geospatial Telemetry (OGC WFS) — Floods and Sea Level" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Área Metropolitana de Lisboa . Its keywords include area-metropolitana-de-lisboa, alertas, monitorizacao, geoespacial, wms, wfs. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
